info.title: API.SH: TikTok
info.description: The TikTok API from API.SH: public TikTok data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: Latest videos of a TikTok account
get.description:
Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

The profile's videos, 35 per page; pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`. Logged out, TikTok serves about two pages (~60 videos), then `next_cursor` is null (`more_available` says whether the account has more). `sort` = latest (default), popular or oldest, like the tabs on the profile.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tiktok-channel

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: latest (default), popular or oldest.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Value of `next_cursor` from the previous page (logged out, TikTok serves about two pages).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: TikTok keyword search over a date range
get.description:
Results are the ones TikTok shows to visitors outside the US. Pages TikTok's video search for a keyword and returns every video posted between `date_from` and `date_to` (deduplicated, newest first), reading up to `max_pages` pages of about 12-20 results. `complete` is true when TikTok had no more results; otherwise pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` (same q and dates) to keep going. Priced per page read. Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tiktok-search-full

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keyword.

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD, ISO or unix seconds). Default: 30 days ago.

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD = whole day). Default: now.

parameters.name: max_pages
parameters.description: Pages to read (1-10, default 5).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance or likes.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Value of `next_cursor` from the previous call.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The trending videos TikTok's Creative Center publishes for a country and period (top 4 by views, the view shown without a TikTok for Business login): video id, URL, caption, cover, author with followers, views (period and lifetime), organic views, engagement rate and 6-second view rate. Countries: JP, VN, TH, ID. Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tiktok-trends-videos

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country: JP (default), VN, TH or ID.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Days: 7 (default) or 30.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.note: Logged out, TikTok's Creative Center shows the top videos per country and period; the full ranking needs a TikTok for Business login.

get.description:
Download links for a TikTok post: the best no-watermark MP4 (`no_watermark.url`, a link that redirects to the file and needs no cookies), every encoded variant (gear, codec, bitrate, resolution, size), the watermarked file when the site publishes one, the audio track (`audio.url`), cover images, subtitles and, for photo posts, the image URLs. Links expire after a few hours. Short links (vm.tiktok.com, tiktok.com/t/) are accepted.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tiktok-video-download

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: TikTok video URL (https://www.tiktok.com/@user/video/<id>) or a short link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
